description: This file defines Pydantic models used for the NoteMaster API, including data schemas for notes and tags, as well as request and response payloads for various operations.

classes.name: NoteBase
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the basic structure of a note, including title, content, tags, and status flags.

classes.name: NoteCreate
classes.description: Request payload for creating a new note, inheriting from NoteBase.

classes.name: NoteUpdate
classes.description: Request payload for updating an existing note, with all fields optional.

classes.name: NoteOut
classes.description: Response schema representing a full note with metadata such as id, timestamps.

classes.name: NoteListOut
classes.description: Schema for listing multiple notes including total count.

classes.name: TagCreate
classes.description: Payload for creating a new tag.

classes.name: TagUpdate
classes.description: Payload for updating a tag's name.

classes.name: TagOut
classes.description: Representation of a tag, including id, name, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: TagListOut
classes.description: Schema for listing tags, including total count.

classes.name: BulkIdsIn
classes.description: Generic payload containing a list of note IDs for bulk operations.

classes.name: BulkDeleteOut
classes.description: Response indicating which note IDs were deleted or not found.

classes.name: BulkTagsIn
classes.description: Payload for bulk tagging operations, specifying note IDs and tag names.

classes.name: BulkTagsOut
classes.description: Response payload for bulk tagging, indicating updated and not found IDs.
